description: record_transition_decide(state, input) parity cases generated from transitionEnvelope() in src/lib/records/companyStep.ts (gap/08 §C; D-30, D-32, D-51). Cases are in four sections, in this order: lattice (every valid kind combination x status x action x actor with passing inputs), guards (every missing input, open requests, stale signatures, version and slot-completion variant for every action and status), history (closedBy x cycles x acknowledgements x delete rules for acknowledge / remove_company_signature / void / reopen / return_to_vessel), random (seeded, both spellings of every default). expected is either an index into `values` (the whole TS outcome value, effects in TS order: {ok:true, value: values[expected]}) or the TS error code ({ok:false, error:{code}}). Absent keys mean the TS default. Regenerate with node scripts/db/gen-record-fixtures.mjs; never edit by hand.
